display_long_description:
Your room. A little magic. A friend to share it with.

Welcome a glowing sprite into your space. Catch the stars it throws, share a melody or settle into a quiet breathing break. Wall Sprites blends playful challenges and gentle company in a single-player mixed-reality experience.

FIVE GAMES, 100 LEVELS
Start small and see how far you can go:
• Catch a Star: react to faster throws from changing directions, with up to four stars at once.
• Firefly Trail: catch glowing lights before they fade.
• Star Pairs: match pictures on bigger, more challenging boards.
• Follow the Melody: remember longer bell sequences and earn points for your recall.
• Tic-tac-toe: take on an increasingly skilful sprite.
Replay favourites, beat your best scores and unlock the next challenge.

A MOMENT JUST FOR YOU
Play three notes and hear your companion answer. Slow down with four gentle breathing guides, choosing a visible room, dim background or black backdrop. Follow at your own comfortable pace, with no breath holds.

MORE LITTLE FRIENDS TO MEET
Ten daily minutes, added across visits, earn a play day. Unlock a companion every seven play days and a rare one every 90. Days use UTC; no streak required.

Games and earnable companions are included. Fixes stay free; future expansion packs are optional purchases.

Hand tracking and supported controller interactions; some gestures need hands. Progress is saved locally on your headset. Stay seated for breathing. For relaxation, not medical treatment.
